fictional_item.title: Lunaria Pod: A Quiet Imaginary Desk Garden
fictional_item.description: Fictional concept, invented for a creative brief. The Lunaria Pod is an imaginary desk garden: a palm-sized dome of frosted glass in which make-believe silver-leafed moonwort is said to unfurl slowly whenever the room goes still. In this story, the pod hums a note too soft to hear and gives off a pale, pearly glow that exists only on the page. Its tiny garden follows an invented lunar rhythm, opening at dusk and folding closed at dawn. Nothing here describes a real product, plant, recording or event. No footage or images exist, and no performance or wellbeing claims are made. It is a small piece of whimsy for anyone who likes to picture a calmer corner of their desk.
